dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies with independent leasing authorities, the GAO, OMB, and the Public Buildings Reform Board.
dimensions.evidence: The Director and Administrator shall provide to the Comptroller General of the United States all data and reports

dimensions.assessment: Improves federal real estate reporting, oversight accountability, and building retention options.
Requires that the cost of retaining swing space does not exceed savings realized from building sales or renovations.
dimensions.evidence: the cost of retaining such building does not exceed any savings realized by the sale or major renovation of any other Federal building

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Thomas R. Carper Water Resources Development Act of 2024 and the Federal Assets Sale and Transfer Act.
Extends the Public Buildings Reform Board through December 31, 2028, and establishes ongoing oversight duties.

missing_information: Specific financial savings expected from retaining swing spaces.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends public building and leasing oversight laws to require data sharing with the GAO and Public Buildings Reform Board, and establishes swing space exceptions.
